title: selliguea taiwanensis
intro: Selliguea taiwanensis, commonly known as the Taiwanese polypody, is a species of fern native to Taiwan. It is a medicinal herb used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Selliguea taiwanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
